notes: Source: the managing company Meitav Gemel and Pension Ltd (מיטב גמל ופנסיה בע"מ) own report, from the company website (meitav.co.il, page "דוחות קרנות הפנסיה", section "דוח כספי - חברה מנהלת"; file served as mrkmd.meitav.co.il/media/reports/ and www.meitav.co.il/Reports/uploadfiles/). The company does not report on MAYA (MAYA reports under reporter 1064 are the listed parent Meitav Investment House). The listed parent was not used.
Amounts in NIS thousand as printed (members = count; fee rates = percent). Negative values printed in parentheses are kept negative; a dash is recorded as value null with a note.

Per-fund-type tables (directors' report / description of the business, section "נתונים אודות פעילות בתחום קופות הגמל וקרנות הפנסיה"): segment pension_new = new pension funds, comprehensive (מקיפה) and general (כללית) as separate columns (fund_type); provident = personal gemel for compensation and severance, study funds, investment gemel, child-savings gemel and "other" central funds (fund_type); total = column "סך הכל" (pension + provident). sub = population (active / inactive / recipients = pensioners / total / active_and_inactive). No aggregate across columns was calculated.

Column identity was checked on every table page against the printed column headers (x-position of the header words). Every additive row was checked: the "סך הכל" column equals the sum of the seven fund-type columns.
Flow and fee windows are cumulative from 1 January: q in Q1, ytd in Q2/Q3 (six / nine months), fy in annual reports and for the year-end comparative.

Segment note (ביאור מגזרי פעילות): provident = מגזר הגמל, pension = מגזר הפנסיה (new pension funds only), total = whole company; the column "לא מיוחס למגזרי פעילות" (unallocated investment gains / finance items) is not recorded as a segment but is included in the total column.

selling_and_marketing_expenses = "עמלות, הוצאות שיווק והוצאות רכישה אחרות" as printed: acquisition commissions net of capitalised deferred acquisition costs plus current amortisation of deferred acquisition costs (note 16 / note 5). general_and_administrative_expenses = "הוצאות הנהלה וכלליות" as printed (net of amounts classified to commissions).

Meitav pays a management fee to its controlling company (דמי ניהול לחברה בעלת שליטה, ~1/3 of fee revenue); it is a separate expense line, recorded as management_fees_to_controlling_company, and is not part of selling_and_marketing_expenses or general_and_administrative_expenses.

Payments to pensioners (rows under תשלומים: זכאים קיימים לפנסיה, מקבלי קצבה קיימים, פנסיונרים), actuarial surplus rows, the dormant-accounts tables and the direct-expense-rate tables are printed but not recorded (outside the v7 metric list).

Interim reports print three table sets in the directors' report: the current period (cumulative from 1 January), the same date of the prior year, and the full prior year (31.12.2023). All three are recorded, each with its own date; the 31.12.2023 flows/fees are window fy.
aum segment totals (sub total, segment provident / pension_new / total) are from the directors' report table "היקף הנכסים המנוהלים על ידי החברה" (section 3), which prints three dates.
